message.content:
The illustration shows a vertical magazine cover with a textured, green-toned background resembling a cracked wall. In the center, an illustrated palm tree extends from the bottom edge, its trunk brown and textured with diamond-shaped bark patterns. At the top of the trunk, bunches of small, dark fruit cluster beneath large, stylized green palm fronds. An illustrated woman with short, dark hair and light skin peeks from behind the left side of the tree trunk. She is wearing a cream-colored top and a golden bangle on her left wrist. She holds several stacks of grey banknotes in her left hand, fanning them out as she grips the tree trunk. One banknote also hangs from the cluster of fruit.

The word "TEMPO" is printed in large, white, serif capital letters across the top. Below this, in smaller white text, is "EDISI 23-29 JULI 2012". On the right side, large black sans-serif text reads "'SUAP' SAWIT MADAM HARTATI". Across the top margin, three yellow headlines are visible: "JEJARING PAJAK ANGGRAH SURYO", "JOKI MASSAL ALA UGM", and "AGUS BERTAHAN DI SELAT SUNDA". The bottom left corner contains price information, a website, a barcode, and publication details. A red border runs along the left and bottom edges of the frame.
